stdout.text:
Generate the autocompletion script for symvault for the specified shell.
See each sub-command's help for details on how to use the generated script.

Usage:
  symvault completion [command]

Available Commands:
  bash        Generate the autocompletion script for bash
  fish        Generate the autocompletion script for fish
  powershell  Generate the autocompletion script for powershell
  zsh         Generate the autocompletion script for zsh

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for completion

Global Flags:
      --color string      When to emit ANSI color: auto, always, never (default "auto")
      --json              Output format shorthand for --output json; overrides --output when both are specified
      --no-pipe-warning   suppress 'reading from non-TTY' warning when piping secrets
      --output string     Output format (text, json, yaml) (default "text")
      --profile string    use a named vault profile
      --quiet             suppress non-error output
      --theme string      Color preset: default, highcontrast, colorblind (or SYMVAULT_THEME)
      --vault string      path to the password vault (default "~/.symvault")

Use "symvault completion [command] --help" for more information about a command.
